technical.summary: Mixed bullish structure with EMA golden cross and price above key moving averages, but overbought oscillators, weak momentum indicators, and bearish candle pattern create meaningful entry risk.

fundamental.summary: MO shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 57 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (12/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction (small purchases by non-senior members, 131+ days old) and absent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (356.16) with flat yield curve, imminent NFP event in 2 days, and 57-day earnings window create hostile macro conditions for MO trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA 9/21 golden cross with price above 200-EMA provides technical structure, and extreme fear (12/100) offers contrarian entry opportunity in oversold sentiment regime.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (Stoch, Williams %R, StochRSI), three black crows bearish pattern, zero momentum confirmation (AO negative, CMF weak), weak volume support (0.6 ratio), and hostile macro (VIX crisis 356.16, imminent NFP, 57-day earnings risk) create compounding entry risk that outweighs technical setup.

decision.entry_rationale: EMA 9/21 golden cross with price above 200-EMA provides structural bullish setup, and extreme fear sentiment (12/100) offers contrarian opportunity. However, overbought oscillators, three black crows pattern, zero momentum confirmation, and hostile macro environment (VIX crisis, imminent NFP, 57-day earnings) create compounding risk that exceeds reward.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis regime (356.16) combined with imminent NFP event in 2 days and 57-day earnings window creates macro volatility that will likely trigger stop-losses before technical setup can develop.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on elevated risk; debate decisively favors bear case (8 vs 4)
decision.portfolio_note: Zero existing MO or Consumer Staples exposure; portfolio drawdown at 0% allows full sizing, but macro hostility and earnings proximity warrant avoidance rather than concentration.
